methods.keep_review: Exact KEEP is measured against the original source and immediate parent separately. Title-only changes and body equality are identified.
methods.scope: Focused AI review, unblinded and by fixture author. No external factual verification or exhaustive human copy-edit.
methods.prompt_contents: Arm labels and model controls are from records; package contents and full prompts are not independently reconstructed here.
